conditions: The API reference is marked Preview; verify Free-plan access and the deployed Cloud version before asserting scoped availability.
The documented path is inbound SCIM User provisioning into an organization, not outbound provisioning into the consuming SaaS.
Service-account authorization, user deactivation/deletion and consuming-application permissions or sessions require separate integration tests.

evidence.summary: The Preview API reference documents organization-scoped User CRUD and service-account authentication. It does not establish this untested Free Cloud instance's release, entitlement or lifecycle enforcement.

conditions: This negative assertion is limited to native inbound SCIM Group provisioning in the User-only interface, with no external bridge or extension.
Do not generalize it to every ZITADEL group/membership integration; application-side bridges and other APIs are outside this option's scope and remain unassessed.
A login claim or SCIM user record is not synchronized group membership in the consuming application's authorization model.

evidence.summary: The current SCIM guide explicitly excludes Group provisioning and extended schemas. This documents absence in the native SCIM interface, not a provider-wide impossibility.
